title: ClickUp Pricing 2026: Unlimited vs Business, the New Core and Max Plans, and Automation Limits
snippet:
ClickUp costs $0 on Free Forever, $9 per user a month on Core, $17 on Business and $100 on Max billed yearly, with Enterprise quoted, as of October 29, 2026. AI credits are now included in every plan, and the old Unlimited $7 / Business $12 lineup is gone.

**As of October 29, 2026, ClickUp's pricing page lists Free Forever at $0, Core at $9 per user a month billed yearly, Business at $17 and Max at $100 (regular prices $12, $25 and $120), plus a custom Enterprise plan. AI credits are now built into every plan instead of sold as an add-on. The plan that can send a webhook to another app is Business, so that is where an automated team really starts.**

| Plan | Per user a month billed yearly (regular price) | Automation actions a month | AI credits | MCP calls a day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free Forever | $0 | 100 per workspace | 500 per workspace | 100 |
| Core | $9 ($12) | 1,000 | 1,000 per user, pooled | 300 |
| Business | $17 ($25) | 10,000 | 1,500 per user, pooled | 1,000 |
| Enterprise | Custom | 1,000,000 | 3,000 per user, pooled | 25,000 |
| Max | $100 ($120) | 1,000,000 | 10,000 per user, pooled | No daily cap |
Free has 60 MB of storage, five active automation rules and one form. Core adds unlimited storage, spaces, forms, custom fields and Gantt charts, plus guest permissions. Business adds advanced dashboards, resource management, Google sign-in, private views and docs, timesheets, and the advanced automations (webhooks, email, SMS and integration actions). Enterprise adds SAML single sign-on, SCIM, audit logs, custom roles, HIPAA and data residency. Max bundles everything in Enterprise with ClickUp's top AI tier at a listed price.
AI credits are pooled across the workspace and pay for Super Agents, AI fields, image generation and similar features. Extra credits cost $10 per 10,000 on any plan. The API stays at 100 calls a minute on Free, Core and Business and goes to 10,000 a minute on Enterprise and Max. The MCP column matters if you plan to let Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant work inside ClickUp: at 300 calls a day, Core supports light use, not an agent that touches tasks all day.

title: Core, Business, Max and AI Credit Costs · Jenzo
snippet:
ClickUp pricing, as of November 2026, has five public plans: Free Forever at $0, Core at $9, Business at $17 and Max at $100 per user a month billed yearly ($12, $25 and $120 billed monthly), plus Enterprise at a custom price. Paid plans now include a pooled AI credit allowance of 1,000 to 10,000 credits per seat a month.

| Plan | Yearly billing (per user a month) | Monthly billing | AI credits (pooled) | Automation actions a month | MCP calls a day (Model Context Protocol) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free Forever | $0 | $0 | 500 per workspace, trial | 100 (5 active rules) | 100 |
| Core | $9 | $12 | 1,000 per user | 1,000 | 300 |
| Business | $17 | $25 | 1,500 per user | 10,000 | 1,000 |
| Business Plus (not on the public page) | $28, per ZenPilot | not listed | 2,000 per seat | 100,000, per ZenPilot | not listed |
| Enterprise | Contact sales | Contact sales | 3,000 per user | 1,000,000 | 25,000 |
| Max | $100 | $120 | 10,000 per user | 1,000,000 | No daily cap |

ClickUp costs $12 per user a month on Core, $25 on Business and $120 on Max if you pay month to month.

Each plan caps storage, automations, dashboards and structure, and the caps on Free and Core are where most teams hit a wall. From the pricing page as of November 17, 2026:
- **Free Forever**: 60 MB of storage, 5 Spaces, 100 automation actions a month, 3 whiteboards, 1 form. Dashboards, Gantt and Timeline are trial only.
- **Core**: unlimited storage and Spaces, 1,000 automation actions, 10 whiteboards, unlimited Gantt charts and forms, guest permissions. Dashboards are still trial only.
- **Business**: advanced dashboards, 10,000 automation actions with webhooks, timesheets, time in status, private views and docs, Google SSO.
- **Enterprise**: 1,000,000 automation actions, SAML and SCIM, audit logs, white labeling, data residency and HIPAA support.
- **Max**: everything in Enterprise plus the unlimited AI features above and no daily MCP cap.

### Is ClickUp free to use?
Yes. The Free Forever plan costs $0 with unlimited members, unlimited tasks and 24/7 support. The limits are tight: 60 MB of storage, 5 Spaces, 100 automation actions a month and dashboards on trial only. ClickUp's pricing page says the plan is "so much more than a trial", and most teams outgrow the storage cap first.
### How much is ClickUp per month?
As of November 2026, Core is $12, Business $25 and Max $120 per user a month on monthly billing. Billed yearly, they drop to $9, $17 and $100. Enterprise is quoted by sales.

title: How to Use ClickUp With AI Agents for Free (2026)
snippet:
Yes, ClickUp is free: the [Free Forever plan](https://clickup.com/pricing?ref=sharkly.ai) costs $0 with unlimited free members and unlimited tasks. And yes, AI agents can use it on that plan, because [ClickUp’s official MCP server](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/connect-an-ai-assistant-to-clickups-mcp-server?ref=sharkly.ai) “is available on all plans.”

|---|---|---|---|
| ClickUp | Free Forever | 60MB storage, 5 Spaces, Custom Fields on trial only | Core at $9 per user/month, billed yearly |
| ClickUp MCP server | Included on all plans | 100 calls per rolling 24 hours on Free Forever | Core raises it to 300, Business to 1,000 |

ClickUp’s [pricing page](https://clickup.com/pricing?ref=sharkly.ai) lists Free Forever at $0 with “Unlimited Free Members”, unlimited tasks and subtasks, collaborative Docs, Kanban boards and sprint management. Paid tiers start at Core ($9 per user per month billed yearly, $12 regular), then Business at $17 and Max at $100, with Enterprise on a quote.

- **API: 100 calls per minute.** That’s the pricing table’s figure for Free, if you script against the REST API directly.

ClickUp’s side is already free. On the agent side, Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan or API credits, and Codex signs in with a ChatGPT account or an API key whose included usage depends on the plan.
OpenCode is the route that costs nothing. Its [Zen docs](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen?ref=sharkly.ai) list several models as free “for a limited time” today, including `deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` and `glm-5.3-flash-free`. On October 16, 2026, a clean OpenCode 1.19.2 install (via `npx opencode-ai@latest`) ran `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` with no sign-in and no API key, and a write-and-run task finished in 32 seconds. Add the model to the same config:
```json
"model": "opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free"
```
ClickUp Free Forever plus OpenCode plus a free model is $0 on every line. The honest limits:
- The free tier works only inside the OpenCode program. Direct API calls get HTTP 403 `FreeTierError`.
- “Limited time” ends without much notice. Recheck the Zen page, and keep the model in one config line.
- Smaller free models tend to explore with more tool calls. With 100 MCP calls a day, tell the agent the exact task or List to work on instead of letting it search the workspace.
- Free models carry their own data terms on the Zen page. Read them before a private repo goes near one.

**Is ClickUp free?** Yes. Free Forever costs $0 with unlimited free members
